name: U-density Function
definition: A rendering weight function $w_r(t)$ derived from a UDF $	au_r(t)$ to solve the volume-surface gap and guarantee global unbiased property, avoiding redundant floating faces and irregular noises caused by SDF-based extensions.
summary: The U-density function is a rendering weight function for Unsigned Distance Fields that ensures globally unbiased volume rendering by concentrating weight near the first surface intersection to prevent artifacts.
